Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
Are you open on Saturdays? And can I use insurance?

Yes, we're open on Saturdays from 9 AM to 7 PM. As for insurance, whether it can be used depends on your situation and the type of injury. Our staff can explain the details when you visit. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
